name: Soccer Pro ⚽ (3v3)
desc:
Team Soccer is a skill-based soccer game built around team play and authentic ball physics.

Matches play true to soccer, while fun cosmetic elements—like unique ball designs—add style without affecting gameplay.
Just skill, teamwork, and competitive matches with friends.

CONTROLS: 
Shift - Sprint
E - Tackle
Q - Dribble
V - Mouse lock
Hold Left Click - Kick
Spacebar - Header

🐦
